text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That day, having wrapped up training early,
Mejiro Ramonu quietly read through a mountain of fan letters."
choice_data_list: There's quite a lot here, why not read them at your own pace in the dorm?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—These are sparks of love.
In all their vibrant colors.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Some wrote fourteen-line sonnets,
while others sent in thesis-style papers filled with data.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Every form of love is magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Besides—each and every one of them is burning hot.
Do you understand why?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When I shook my head, Mejiro Ramonu gestured toward the letter with her eyes. To discern her true intentions, I reviewed the letter's contents once more. And then—
choice_data_list: They're all writing about the last race!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, a little girl begged her parents saying,
"I wanna take a picture with that Umamusume!",
putting them in quite a pinch.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: At first glance, it seems like simple begging.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yet, all of them were merely sparks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I will become the flame of love feeding the race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A single letter, and Mejiro Ramonu.
For some reason, the scene carried a divine aura.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the color of the sunset, I saw a tiny flame.
A flame it was, but a warm, gentle one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Waiting until it cools down—no way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ramonu begins reading the letters once more.
Cherishing each and every page—
